catalog.name: Pi
catalog.description: Run the Pi coding agent as a chat provider over its RPC protocol.
catalog.hint: The `pi` id is reserved: this card is served over Pi's own RPC protocol (mid-turn steering, effort control, slash commands), not ACP. Connect a subscription by running `pi` in a Terminal once and typing /login, or paste provider API keys into the environment block.

steps: Add this capability — it bakes the Pi CLI into the sandbox image (a one-time rebuild).
Connect a model: run `pi` in a Terminal and type /login for a Claude/ChatGPT/Copilot subscription, or add API keys as `KEY=VALUE` lines in the environment block.
Pick a default model inside Pi with /model — Pi owns its model catalog.
Pi then appears as a provider in the chat's model picker.
